local_map.title: Fully local connection
local_map.description: IP address and 32-character token. Everything runs over your LAN. You get the token with the guide's tools ({guide_url}); afterwards load the map with **Configure → Download the map from your Xiaomi account**. Easier: go back and choose **Xiaomi account once → fully local**.

account_local.title: Sign in once to your Xiaomi account
account_local.description: Use the account your robot is paired to in Mi Home. The integration finds the robot (IP address and token) and downloads its map **once**. Your password and the Xiaomi session are **not stored**: after setup everything runs over your local network, and you can block the robot from the internet on your router.

data.username: Email, phone number or Mi account ID

saved_device.title: Confirm your robot
saved_device.description: Found **{robot}**. Check its local IP address (set a fixed address for it on your router if you can) and choose a name — entity ids are created from the name. Next, the map is downloaded once; the robot may stay offline for this.

reconfigure.title: Change the robot's IP address
reconfigure.description: Current address: **{current}**. Enter the new one (tip: reserve a fixed address for the robot on your router). It is checked against the robot before saving; the map, settings and entities stay as they are.

map_refresh.description: Use this after first setup or after you re-mapped your home or changed rooms in Mi Home. The robot does **not** need internet if it uploaded its map earlier; after changes in Mi Home let it stay online until the app shows the new map. Your password and session are not stored.

saved_map_outdated.title: Saved map looks outdated
saved_map_outdated.description: The robot cleaned room ids {rooms} that are not in the saved map. The robot's map has probably changed. Bring the robot online briefly, check the map in Mi Home, then run tools/dump_map.py and import the new copy with jonr_local.import_map.

saved_map_missing.title: Your robot's map is not downloaded yet
saved_map_missing.description:
Room cleaning, room names and the map card need the robot's map. Get it once:

1. **Settings → Devices & services → JONR Local → Configure**.
2. Choose **Download / refresh the map from your Xiaomi account** and sign in.

Your password is not stored and the robot may stay offline. If it says there is no map yet, map your home in the Mi Home app first (robot online).

state.lost_return_to_station: Lost — return the robot to the station

clean_segment.name: Clean room(s)
clean_segment.description: Start cleaning one or more rooms by their map room id.

segments.name: Rooms
segments.description: List of room ids to clean (from the map camera's "rooms" attribute).

map_id.name: Floor (map id)
map_id.description: Map id of the floor the rooms belong to (sent by the map card). Refused if it is not the active floor. Omit for the active floor.

refresh_map.name: Refresh map
refresh_map.description: Briefly starts the vacuum so it leaves the dock and uploads a fresh map, then sends it back to dock.

confirm_movement.name: Confirm movement
confirm_movement.description: Must be true. The vacuum will briefly leave the dock and return.

import_map.name: Import saved map
import_map.description: Fully local entries only: store a map copy downloaded once from the cloud (tools/dump_map.py). Room ids, names and the map image come from this copy.

map_raw.name: Map file
map_raw.description: Content of map_raw.json from the dump.

source.name: Source
source.description: Free text stored with the copy (e.g. dump folder name).
